name: Oddish

1.name: Poison Powder
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavour_text: If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move. It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.

name: Gloom
flavour_text: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.

name: Bellossom

1.name: Petal Dance
1.effect: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 60 damage for each heads. This Pokémon is now Confused.

flavour_text: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

name: Tangela

1.name: Sleep Powder
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

flavour_text: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon’s true appearance remains a mystery.

name: Tangrowth

1.name: Grass Knot
1.effect: This attack does 40 more damage for each Energy in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

flavour_text: Tangrowth has two arms that it can extend as it pleases. Recent research has shown that these arms are, in fact, bundles of vines.

name: Scyther
flavour_text: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

name: Pinsir
flavour_text: These Pokémon judge one another based on pincers. Thicker, more impressive pincers make for more popularity with the opposite gender.

name: Chikorita
flavour_text: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up sun rays.

name: Bayleef
flavour_text: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.

name: Meganium

1.name: Bloomshine
1.effect: Heal 20 damage from each of your Pokémon.

flavour_text: The aroma that rises from its petals contains a substance that calms aggressive feelings.

name: Ledyba
flavour_text: These very cowardly Pokémon join together and use Reflect to protect their nest.

name: Ledian
flavour_text: It’s said that the patterns on its back are related to the stars in the night sky, but the details of that relationship remain unclear.

name: Hoppip
flavour_text: Outside of cold regions, Hoppip can be found practically everywhere. This is because the wind carries this species all over the world.

name: Skiploom
flavour_text: Skiploom enthusiasts can apparently tell where a Skiploom was born by the scent drifting from the flower on the Pokémon’s head.

name: Jumpluff

ability.name: Fluffy Flight
ability.effect: Your Active Pokémon has no Retreat Cost.

flavour_text: Jumpluff travels on seasonal winds. Once its cotton spores run out, its journey ends, as does its life.

name: Sunkern

1.name: Blot
1.effect: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. Knowing it’s weak, it simply feeds until it evolves.

name: Sunflora
flavour_text: In the daytime, it rushes about in a hectic manner, but it comes to a complete stop when the sun sets.

name: Yanma

1.name: U-turn
1.effect: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its head. It won’t miss prey—even those behind it.

name: Yanmega
flavour_text: It prefers to battle by biting apart foes’ heads instantly while flying by at high speed.

name: Pineco
flavour_text: It looks just like a pinecone. Its shell protects it from bird Pokémon that peck it by mistake.

ability.name: Solid Shell
ability.effect: This Pokémon takes −20 damage from attacks.

1.name: Triple Slap
1.effect: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

name: Heracross

1.name: Single Lunge
1.effect: If this Pokémon has no damage on it, this attack does 40 more damage.

flavour_text: It loves sweet nectar. To keep all the nectar to itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.

name: Cherubi

ability.name: En-fruits-iastic
ability.effect: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, attacks used by this Pokémon cost 1 less [G] Energy.

1.name: Sweets Relay
1.effect: If 1 of your Pokémon used Sweets Relay during your last turn, this attack does 20 more damage.

flavour_text: It nimbly dashes about to avoid getting pecked by bird Pokémon that would love to make off with its small, nutrient-rich storage ball.

name: Cherrim
flavour_text: After absorbing plenty of sunlight, Cherrim takes this form. It’s full of energy while it’s like this, and its liveliness will go on until sundown.

name: Vulpix
flavour_text: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

name: Ninetales

1.name: Scorching Breath
1.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

flavour_text: It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.

name: Cyndaquil
flavour_text: It is timid and always curls itself up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.

name: Quilava
flavour_text: Before battle, it turns its back on its opponent to demonstrate how ferociously its fire blazes.

name: Typhlosion

ability.name: Fire Breath
ability.effect: Once during your turn, you may make your opponent's Active Pokémon Burned.

flavour_text: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.

name: Slugma
flavour_text: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

name: Magcargo

1.name: Spurt Fire
1.effect: 1 other Pokémon (either yours or your opponent's) is chosen at random 3 times. For each time a Pokémon was chosen, do 50 damage to it.

flavour_text: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

name: Magby

1.name: Toasty Toss
1.effect: Take a [R] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched Basic Pokémon.

flavour_text: This Pokémon is still small and timid. Whenever Magby gets excited or surprised, flames leak from its mouth and its nose.

name: Entei

1.name: Strong Flare
1.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, discard 2 random Energy from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

1.name: Phoenix Turbo
1.effect: Take a [R], [W], and [L] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach them to your Benched Basic Pokémon in any way you like.

name: Darumaka
flavour_text: It derives its power from fire burning inside its body. If the fire dwindles, this Pokémon will immediately fall asleep.

name: Darmanitan
flavour_text: The thick arms of this hot-blooded Pokémon can deliver punches capable of obliterating a dump truck.

name: Heatmor

1.name: Roasting Heat
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Burned, this attack does 60 more damage.

flavour_text: There’s a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.

name: Poliwag
flavour_text: For Poliwag, swimming is easier than walking. The swirl pattern on its belly is actually part of the Pokémon’s innards showing through the skin.

name: Poliwhirl
flavour_text: Staring at the swirl on its belly causes drowsiness. This trait of Poliwhirl’s has been used in place of lullabies to get children to go to sleep.

name: Politoed

ability.name: Lordly Cheering
ability.effect: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, attacks used by your Pokémon that evolve from Poliwhirl do +40 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: At nightfall, these Pokémon appear on the shores of lakes. They announce their territorial claims by letting out cries that sound like shouting.

name: Horsea
flavour_text: Horsea makes its home in oceans with gentle currents. If this Pokémon is under attack, it spits out pitch-black ink and escapes.

name: Seadra
flavour_text: It’s the males that raise the offspring. While Seadra are raising young, the spines on their backs secrete thicker and stronger poison.

1.name: Stormy Prison
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

name: Magikarp

1.name: Splashing Dodge
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.

flavour_text: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

name: Gyarados

1.name: Wild Swing
1.effect: You may discard any number of your Benched [W] Pokémon. This attack does 40 more damage for each Benched Pokémon you discarded in this way.

flavour_text: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

name: Totodile
flavour_text: It is small but rough and tough. It won’t hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

name: Croconaw
flavour_text: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

name: Feraligatr

1.name: Destructive Whirlpool
1.effect: Discard a random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

name: Marill
flavour_text: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry even when it plays in the water.

name: Azumarill

ability.name: Thick Fat
ability.effect: This Pokémon takes −30 damage from attacks from [R] or [W] Pokémon.

flavour_text: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of things in water and tell what they are.

name: Wooper
flavour_text: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

name: Quagsire
flavour_text: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn’t care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.

name: Qwilfish

1.name: Poison Sting
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavour_text: Be cautious if this Pokémon starts sucking in water—it will soon attack by scattering the toxic spikes that grow all over its body.

name: Corsola

1.name: Find a Friend
1.effect: Put a random Pokémon from your deck into your hand.

flavour_text: It will regrow any branches that break off its head. People keep particularly beautiful Corsola branches as charms to promote safe childbirth.

name: Remoraid
flavour_text: The water they shoot from their mouths can hit moving prey from more than 300 feet away.

name: Octillery

1.name: Octazooka
1.effect: If the Defending Pokémon tries to use an attack, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen. This effect lasts until the Defending Pokémon leaves the Active Spot, and it doesn't stack.

flavour_text: Its instinct is to bury itself in holes. It often steals the nesting holes of others to sleep in them.

name: Delibird

1.name: Stumbling Draw
1.effect: Draw a card.

flavour_text: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.

name: Mantine

1.name: Dive
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.

flavour_text: While elegantly swimming in the sea, it ignores Remoraid that cling to its fins seeking food scraps.

name: Suicune

1.name: Cure Stream
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon do −20 damage.

flavour_text: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.

name: Corphish
flavour_text: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.

name: Crawdaunt

ability.name: Unruly Claw
ability.effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may discard a random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws. It is said to be extremely hard to raise.

name: Ducklett
flavour_text: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

name: Swanna

1.name: Feathery Cyclone
1.effect: Move all Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.

name: Chinchou
flavour_text: Its antennae, which evolved from a fin, have both positive and negative charges flowing through them.

1.name: Flashing Signal
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

name: Pichu

1.name: Crackly Toss
1.effect: Take a [L] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched Basic Pokémon.

flavour_text: It is unskilled at storing electric power. Any kind of shock causes it to discharge energy spontaneously.

name: Mareep
flavour_text: If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.

name: Flaaffy
flavour_text: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won’t grow.

name: Ampharos

1.name: Thunder Punch
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 more damage. If tails, this Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

flavour_text: The bright light on its tail can be seen far away. It has been treasured since ancient times as a beacon.

name: Elekid

1.name: Zappy Shot
1.effect: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: When a storm approaches, this Pokémon gets restless. Once Elekid hears the sound of thunder, it gets full-on rowdy.

name: Raikou

1.name: Thunder
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

flavour_text: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.

name: Emolga

1.name: Raging Thunder
1.effect: This attack also does 10 damage to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: As Emolga flutters through the air, it crackles with electricity. This Pokémon is cute, but it can cause a lot of trouble.

name: Slowpoke

1.name: Rest
1.effect: This Pokémon is now Asleep. Heal 30 damage from it.

flavour_text: It is incredibly slow and dopey. It takes five seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

name: Slowking

1.name: Psychic
1.effect: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: When its head was bitten, toxins entered Slowpoke’s head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

name: Smoochum

1.name: Shivery Wave
1.effect: This attack does 20 damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: If its face gets even slightly dirty, Smoochum will bathe immediately. But if its body gets dirty, Smoochum doesn’t really seem to care.

name: Jynx

1.name: Attract Smack
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavour_text: Its strange cries sound like human language. There are some musicians who compose songs for Jynx to sing.

name: Cleffa

1.name: Twinkly Call
1.effect: Put a random Pokémon from your deck into your hand.

flavour_text: According to local rumors, Cleffa are often seen in places where shooting stars have fallen.

name: Togepi

1.name: Charm
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon do −20 damage.

flavour_text: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

name: Togetic
flavour_text: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

name: Togekiss

ability.name: Celestial Blessing
ability.effect: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.

flavour_text: These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they’ve hardly been seen at all.

name: Natu
flavour_text: It is extremely good at climbing tree trunks and likes to eat the new sprouts on the trees.

name: Xatu

1.name: Life Drain
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon's remaining HP is now 10.

flavour_text: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

ability.name: Psychic Healing
ability.effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

name: Unown

ability.name: GUARD
ability.effect: This Ability works if you have any Unown in play with an Ability other than GUARD. All of your Pokémon take −10 damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.

flavour_text: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

name: Unown

ability.name: POWER
ability.effect: This Ability works if you have any Unown in play with an Ability other than POWER. Attacks used by your Pokémon do +10 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

name: Wobbuffet

1.name: Reply Strongly
1.effect: If this Pokémon was damaged by an attack during your opponent's last turn while it was in the Active Spot, this attack does 50 more damage.

flavour_text: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to pump up its counterstrike.

name: Girafarig

1.name: Psybeam
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

flavour_text: Girafarig’s tail has a small head. It instinctively bites at any foe that approaches the Pokémon from behind.

name: Snubbull
flavour_text: It grows close to others easily and is also easily spoiled. The disparity between its face and its actions makes many young people wild about it.

name: Granbull

1.name: Wild Tackle
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

flavour_text: While it has powerful jaws, it doesn’t care for disputes, so it rarely has a chance to display their might.

name: Munna
flavour_text: Late at night, it appears beside people’s pillows. As it feeds on dreams, the patterns on its body give off a faint glow.

name: Musharna

1.name: Dream Dance
1.effect: Both Active Pokémon are now Asleep.

flavour_text: When dark mists emanate from its body, don’t get too near. If you do, your nightmares will become reality.

name: Onix
flavour_text: As it digs through the ground, it absorbs many hard objects. This is what makes its body so solid.

name: Sudowoodo
flavour_text: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.

name: Gligar
flavour_text: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

name: Gliscor
flavour_text: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

name: Swinub
flavour_text: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

name: Piloswine
flavour_text: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.

name: Mamoswine

1.name: Earthquake
1.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: This Pokémon can be spotted in wall paintings from as far back as 10,000 years ago. For a while, it was thought to have gone extinct.

name: Phanpy

1.name: Reckless Charge
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

flavour_text: This Pokémon lives and nests on a riverbank. After playing in the mud, it won’t be able to settle down unless it washes its body.

1.name: Gigantic Press
1.effect: If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra [F] Energy attached, this attack does 60 more damage.

name: Tyrogue
flavour_text: It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.

name: Hitmontop

1.name: Piercing Spin
1.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

name: Larvitar
flavour_text: Born deep underground, this Pokémon becomes a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain.

name: Pupitar

1.name: Guard Press
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes −30 damage from attacks.

flavour_text: This pupa flies around wildly by venting with great force the gas pressurized inside its body.

name: Binacle

1.name: Dual Chop
1.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

flavour_text: After two Binacle find a suitably sized rock, they adhere themselves to it and live together. They cooperate to gather food during high tide.

name: Barbaracle
flavour_text: Seven Binacle come together to form one Barbaracle. The Binacle that serves as the head gives orders to those serving as the limbs.

name: Zubat

1.name: Venomous Fang
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavour_text: It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings. Even in tight caves, Zubat flies around with skill.

name: Golbat

1.name: Venomous Fang
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavour_text: It loves to drink other creatures’ blood. It’s said that if it finds others of its kind going hungry, it sometimes shares the blood it’s gathered.

1.name: Venomous Slash
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

name: Spinarak
flavour_text: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.

name: Ariados

1.name: Bind Down
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

flavour_text: Every night, it wanders around in search of prey, whose movements it restrains by spewing threads before it bites into them with its fangs.

ability.name: Dark Chase
ability.effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has damage on it to the Active Spot.

name: Murkrow

1.name: Astonish
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent reveals a random card from their hand and shuffles it into their deck.

flavour_text: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

name: Honchkrow
flavour_text: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.

name: Sneasel
flavour_text: This cunning Pokémon hides under the cover of darkness, waiting to attack its prey.

name: Weavile
flavour_text: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

name: Houndour
flavour_text: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.

name: Houndoom

1.name: Diving Swipe
1.effect: Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

flavour_text: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.

name: Tyranitar

ability.name: Energy Plunder
ability.effect: Once during your turn, you may move all [D] Energy from each of your Pokémon to this Pokémon.

flavour_text: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It is so insolent that it doesn’t care about others.

name: Absol

1.name: Leap Over
1.effect: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.

name: Forretress
flavour_text: It remains immovably rooted to its tree. It scatters pieces of its hard shell to drive its enemies away.

name: Steelix
flavour_text: It is said that if an Onix lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.

name: Scizor

1.name: Gale Thrust
1.effect: If this Pokémon moved from your Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does 50 more damage.

flavour_text: This Pokémon’s pincers, which contain steel, can crush any hard object they get ahold of into bits.

1.name: Steel Wing
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes −20 damage from attacks.

name: Mawile
flavour_text: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

name: Klink
flavour_text: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.

name: Klang
flavour_text: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon’s rotation speed increases sharply.

name: Klinklang

1.name: Gear Spinner
1.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Gear Spinner attack does +70 damage.

flavour_text: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.

name: Spearow
flavour_text: Its reckless nature leads it to stand up to others—even large Pokémon—if it has to protect its territory.

name: Fearow

1.name: Peck Bugs
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a [G] Pokémon, this attack does 40 more damage.

flavour_text: Carrying food through Fearow’s territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!

name: Chansey

1.name: Scrunch
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks.

flavour_text: This kindly Pokémon lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

name: Blissey

1.name: Energy Blow
1.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to this Pokémon.

flavour_text: Anyone who takes even one taste of Blissey’s egg becomes unfailingly caring and pleasant to everyone.

name: Kangaskhan

1.name: Cross-Cut
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 40 more damage.

flavour_text: Although it’s carrying its baby in a pouch on its belly, Kangaskhan is swift on its feet. It intimidates its opponents with quick jabs.

name: Eevee

1.name: Find a Friend
1.effect: Put a random Pokémon from your deck into your hand.

flavour_text: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

name: Porygon
flavour_text: State-of-the-art technology was used to create Porygon. It was the first artificial Pokémon to be created via computer programming.

name: Porygon2

ability.name: Buggy Evolution
ability.effect: Whenever you attach an Energy from your Energy Zone to this Pokémon, put a random card from your deck that evolves from this Pokémon onto this Pokémon to evolve it.

flavour_text: This is a Porygon that was updated with special data. Porygon2 develops itself by learning about many different subjects all on its own.

name: Porygon-Z

1.name: Slowing Beam
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon cost 1 [C] more.

flavour_text: Porygon-Z had a program installed to allow it to move between dimensions, but the program also caused instability in Porygon-Z’s behavior.

name: Sentret
flavour_text: When acting as a lookout, it warns others of danger by screeching and hitting the ground with its tail.

name: Furret

1.name: Tail Smash
1.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

flavour_text: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.

name: Hoothoot

ability.name: Insomnia
ability.effect: This Pokémon can't be Asleep.

flavour_text: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

name: Noctowl

1.name: Fly
1.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.

flavour_text: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.

name: Aipom

1.name: Imitate
1.effect: Draw cards until you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent.

flavour_text: As it did more and more with its tail, its hands became clumsy. It makes its nest high in the treetops.

name: Ambipom
flavour_text: It uses its tails for everything. If it wraps both of its tails around you and gives you a squeeze, that’s proof it really likes you.

name: Dunsparce

1.name: Sudden Flash
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavour_text: It creates mazes in dark locations. When spotted, it flees into the ground by digging with its tail.

name: Teddiursa

1.name: Honey Snack
1.effect: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: Its paws are soaked in oodles of honey. When nervous, Teddiursa will lick its paws and soon have a smile back on its face.

name: Ursaring

1.name: Swing Around
